name: Blocos de madeira
prompt: Create ONE opaque square material texture for a medieval fantasy battlemap FLOOR. Camera exactly vertically above at 90 degrees, orthographic, no perspective. Finely hand-painted realistic game art matching warm textured timber and natural stone from a high-quality overhead VTT library. Delicate material grain, crisp small-scale detail, natural muted colors. Neutral even overhead lighting across the entire image, no central highlight, vignette or directional shadow. Fill every pixel edge-to-edge with the SAME continuous floor material. Seamless repeat on all four edges. No frame, border, room, walls, furniture, objects, ground patch, text, watermark, grid overlay or transparency. Material: wooden end-grain block paving with small irregular square oak and beech blocks, visible subtle growth rings, twenty blocks across.
